entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
This is absolutely ridiculous! I've been trying to return this VeloBand Pulse and your company is making it impossible. I want this sorted out right now!

I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry for the frustration. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band itself or a preference issue?
It's not about the band, it's about your joke of a service! I tried to process the return two days ago and your entire website was down! I demand to speak to a manager!

I understand you're upset, but I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received the item 11 days ago. Were you trying to return it on day 9?

YES! On day 9! I got a website error page and I couldn't print the label or anything. The whole system was down. I even took a screenshot because I had a feeling you'd try to pull something like this. This is unacceptable.
I see. I do want to apologize for that. We did have a known service outage that day, and it was a major inconvenience for our customers. I'm sorry you were affected by our system being down.
Sorry doesn't cut it! You're going to fix this. I'm not paying for a product I can't return because of your technical failures. I'll post this story and the screenshot on every review site there is!

I completely understand, and that won't be necessary. Let me just double-check our official return policy for you... Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base right now. It clearly states all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
What? 90 days? Are you serious? I thought it was much shorter for these new bands.

Yes, I'm looking right at it. It's a 90-day window. Since you're only on day 11, you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return and email you a new shipping label immediately. The website error won't be an issue at all.
Oh. Well... okay then. If it's 90 days, that's fine. Just send me the label and make sure it actually works this time.
Absolutely. I'm generating it for you as we speak. You should have it in your inbox in the next five minutes. My apologies again for the trouble. Is there anything else I can assist with?
